_SEDEMAC Experience_

Round 1 - Aptitude 

Round 2 - Technical

Duration: 45 minutes
Number of questions: 15 (all multiple-choice)
Topics Covered:
Basic Electronics (like RC circuits)

SHM and fundamental Physics

Battery and Power systems

Engineering Mathematics

Mechanical Engineering fundamentals

Probability and Statistics

Advice: Most questions were based on core concepts you would have studied in JEE or first-year engineering. So a quick revision of those areas will be helpful.
Some questions can be answered through elimination and logical reasoning, even if you are not completely sure of the answer. I personally solved the easier ones first and came back to the harder ones later, which helped manage time.

Round 3: Technical Interview
 
Duration: Around 60 to 70 minutes

Interview Structure:The interview began with a self-introduction, followed by a discussion on the projects mentioned in my resume. Then came around 7 to 8 technical questions. These were designed to test both your conceptual understanding and how you apply that knowledge practically.
Focus Areas:
Analog and digital signal concepts

Time period and waveform basics

Fundamental electronics

Mechanical design and reasoning

Application of mathematical concepts to real-world problems

Basic Programming logic

My Experience: This round was quite challenging and really tested how well I understood the fundamentals. For a few questions, I took a couple of minutes to think carefully before answering, and that was completely fine. The interviewers were more interested in seeing how I approached the problem rather than expecting an instant response, although arriving at the correct answer was still important. What mattered most was being able to logically break down the question, connect it to the relevant concepts, and explain my reasoning clearly. Taking this approach helped me stay calm, and it left a positive impression on the interviewers.
